## Decision semantics

### Deploy health gate

`deploy.sh` polls `/api/health` for `ok` and `corpus_ready` status. It rolls back to the last known-good revision if health checks fail. The script exits with a non-zero status even after a successful rollback, marking the deploy as failed.

### Deploy branch gate

`deploy.sh` refuses to deploy if the working tree is dirty.

UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).

### Index build idempotency

`build_index.py` is idempotent and rewrites the index directory on each run. The `build_matrix` function reads the interactions CSV in chunks of 20 million rows, filtering for ratings greater than zero, and calls `sum_duplicates()` on the resulting CSR matrix to combine duplicate entries.

### Lookup key canonicalisation

`build_lookup` uses the `normkey` function from `bookmatch.match` to generate lookup keys from title and author.

| name | value | consequence |

| `BOOKMATCH_INDEX` | `~/data/goodreads-ucsd/index` (default) | output directory for the built index |
| chunk size | 20 million rows | `build_matrix` reads the interactions CSV in chunks of this size |
| batch size | 50,000 | `build_lookup` inserts books into SQLite in batches of this size |
